purpose: Explicit provenance record for zero-shot methodology and ERA5T role

zero_shot_declaration.statement: This is a zero-shot Nepal inference experiment. The pretrained/fine-tuned Aurora 1.5 model is applied directly to Nepal without any adaptation.

era5t_role.statement: ERA5T (provisional ERA5) is used ONLY as the atmospheric initial condition (IC) for Aurora 1.5 inference. It provides the meteorological state at T=0 from which Aurora autoregressively forecasts 168 hours.
era5t_IS_used_for: Atmospheric initial condition at T=0 for each of 14 daily 00Z initialisations

p2_local_archive.description: P2 phase retrieved ERA5T IC data from ARCO and stored locally as NetCDF files for provenance and validation purposes.
p2_local_archive.purpose: Provenance record and offline validation of IC availability. These files are NOT consumed by the inference pipeline.

runtime_arco_access.description: At inference time, Earth2Studio's ARCO data source fetches the FULL global IC (all pressure levels + surface variables) directly from the ARCO Zarr store.
runtime_arco_access.scope: Full global 0.25 deg IC: 13 pressure levels x 5 atmos vars + 18 surface vars
runtime_arco_access.ic_timestamps_per_init: T-6h and T+0h (two time steps for Aurora's 2-step history)
runtime_arco_access.arco_date_patch: ARCO_TIME_STOP extended from 2025-12-31 to 2026-08-15 on Brev instance (arco.py patched) to access ERA5T dates
runtime_arco_access.purpose: This is the actual IC consumed by Aurora at inference time. Not stored locally beyond GPU memory during the run.

era5t_dual_provenance.distinction: P2 local archive = provenance/validation artifact (surface only, stored). Runtime ARCO = actual IC consumed by Aurora (full global, transient). They access the same underlying ARCO dataset but differ in scope and purpose.
